LESSON: ETIQUETTE OF ISLAMIC WEDDING CELEBRATIONS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.1: Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations
2. Practise Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations in the examples.
2. Explain Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations
2. Practise Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Etiquette of Islamic Wedding Celebrations

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
